Applied NLP Engineer, Customer Feedback Analytics
Reviewly

About the role
Reviewly turns millions of customer feedback comments into themes and trends. You will build the text analytics behind it, working end-to-end from data to a deployed service.

What you'll do
- Build text analytics and topic clustering over customer feedback in Python
- Fine-tune transformer models for sentiment and theme classification
- Evaluate sentence embeddings (SBERT) and clustering methods such as K-Means or DBSCAN
- Explain results to non-technical stakeholders with clear communication skills

What you'll need:
Strong Python and scikit-learn
Experience with NLP on customer feedback or reviews
Proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow; exposure to parameter-efficient techniques such as LoRA is a plus.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

Our Perks
Optional private healthcare plan
